newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich in group to take stake in Handlowy.
newsitem.headline: Zurich in group to take stake in Handlowy.

text.p: Zurich Group said it intended to join a group of investors that will acquire a stake of between 24 and 29.9 percent of Poland's Bank Handlowy.
It also plans to sign a letter of intent with the bank on establishing a joint non-life insurance company and a life insurance company in Poland, it said in a statement.
"The Zurich Group intends to participate as part of a core group of shareholders in the previously announced privatisation of Bank Handlowy, one of the largest banks in Poland," it said.
"This core group will acquire between 24.0 and 29.9 percent of the bank's fully diluted share capital," it added, calling it an excellent opportunity to invest in Poland's growing economy.
It did not identify the other members of the group.

"Furthermore, Zurich and Bank Handlowy plan to sign a letter of intent which outlines future plans to jointly establish a non-life insurance company and a life insurance company in Poland," it said. Each will contribute know-how and customers.
A company spokeswoman said Zurich was part of the three-member group led by J.P. Morgan and Co Inc.
Swedbank, the third partner, said earlier it was interested in buying up to five percent of Handlowy's shares.
The Zurich spokeswoman said the final purchase price depended on the allocation of shares.
